scope: Curve25519-family miniature k = 24, 28, 32, generic-decomposition track at the baby-step giant-step boundary (C = 2 seeds), ecbench counted GAE, local route L1; no signed replay or recompute
statement: ic_autolab round 30 (research/curve25519_autolab_20261104/round-030): the C = 2 box with a stride renewed after every relation (targets=stride-renew) finds no challenger (best train S 3.063, 2.713, 6.017 at k = 24, 28, 32). At k = 32 wsum2r-b120 has no dependent rows but needs 72,469 probes for 3 relations against 28,300 for the walk-probe incumbent: hits of an arithmetic progression against the box cluster on short seed-relation lines, so a renewed stride waits about 2.6 times longer per independent hit.
